summary: Automation hub lets you find and manage certified collections from Red Hat and partners. If private automation hub is installed from an internal address but its certificate covers only the external one, set `automationhub_main_url` (for example `https://pah.example.com`) so the external address is added to `/etc/pulp/settings.py` and the registry works without certificate errors.
